research_themes_active_2024_2026.theme: Hydra oligactis bioelectric immortality vs mortality
Learning in living lineages and machines
Brain-like complex information architectures in Xenopus laevis embryonic organoids
Field-mediated bioelectric basis of morphogenetic prepatterning
Pre-neural left-right asymmetry and serotonergic morphogenetic control

Optogenetic and pharmacological control of bioelectric state (carbenoxolone, ivermectin-gated channels, light-gated Cx hemichannels)
Xenopus laevis embryonic and adult-cell-derived xenobot construction
Adult human airway epithelial cell anthrobot construction
Long-duration time-lapse motility tracking with goal-directed behavior assays (mazes, debris collection, wound closure, group aggregation)
Computational morphogenesis simulation tools (BETSE / Planimal frameworks)
Transcriptomic profiling integrated with bioelectric state
